{
  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    threshold = case['threshold']
    calls = case['calls']
    accepted = []
    diagnostics = []
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call['call_id']
        losswithout = call['loss_without_call']
        losswith = call['loss_with_call']
        tokens = call['prediction_tokens']
        parseable = call['parseable']
        gain = losswithout - losswith
        normalized = gain / tokens
        accept = parseable and (normalized >= threshold)
        diagnostics.append({
            'accepted': accept,
            'call_id': call_id,
            'normalized_gain': normalized
        })
        if accept:
            accepted.append(call_id)
    return {
        'accepted_call_ids': accepted,
        'diagnostics': diagnostics
    }"
}
